details.title: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement

governing_law_source.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India, and the courts at Mumbai shall have exclusive jurisdiction.

details.parties_quote: FINSERVE CAPITAL PRIVATE LIMITED, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013, having its registered office at 11th Floor, One BKC Tower, G Block, Bandra Kurla Complex, Bandra (East), Mumbai 400051, Maharashtra, India (together with its Affiliates, the "Company"); and ATLIQ TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013 (CIN U72900MH2019PTC321456; GSTIN 27AAKCA4821F1Z3), having its registered office at 4th Floor, Baner Business Bay, Pune 411045, Maharashtra, India (the "Recipient")
details.services_summary: Exploration of a potential business relationship concerning the development of data analytics and reporting solutions for the Company's lending and wealth businesses.
details.one_sided_note: While titled mutual, the restrictive covenants in Clause 8 (non-compete and non-solicit) and the indemnity in Clause 10.2 bind only the Recipient (AtliQ).

restrictive_covenants.summary: Recipient shall not provide services similar to those contemplated by the Proposed Transaction to any Competitor.
restrictive_covenants.restricted_activity: provide services similar to those contemplated by the Proposed Transaction to any Competitor
restrictive_covenants.quote: the Recipient shall not, during the term of this Agreement and for a period of twelve (12) months after its termination, provide services similar to those contemplated by the Proposed Transaction to any Competitor.

restrictive_covenants.summary: Recipient shall not solicit, hire or engage any employee or consultant of the Company.
restrictive_covenants.restricted_activity: solicit, hire or engage any employee or consultant of the Company
restrictive_covenants.quote: The Recipient shall not, during the term of this Agreement and for a period of twenty-four (24) months after its termination, directly or indirectly solicit, hire or engage any employee or consultant of the Company.

findings.title: One-sided confidentiality definition
findings.why: The definition only covers information disclosed by the Company, making the NDA effectively one-way despite being titled as a mutual agreement.
findings.comparison: AtliQ principles require confidentiality to be mutual.
findings.quote: Confidential Information means all information... disclosed or made available by or on behalf of the Company to the Recipient

findings.title: Onerous data breach notification timeline
findings.why: A six-hour window is extremely tight and may be operationally impossible to meet, creating a high risk of technical breach.
findings.comparison: Standard industry practice is usually 24-72 hours.
findings.quote: shall notify the Company of any personal data breach within six (6) hours.

findings.title: Perpetual confidentiality obligations
findings.why: Perpetual obligations create an indefinite liability tail for AtliQ, which is difficult to manage and monitor.
findings.comparison: Most AtliQ contracts limit survival to 6-12 months post-term.
findings.quote: The obligations of the Recipient under this Agreement shall survive termination and shall continue in perpetuity.

findings.title: Restrictive non-compete clause
findings.why: This restricts AtliQ's ability to work with other clients in the financial sector, severely limiting business growth.
findings.quote: the Recipient shall not... provide services similar to those contemplated by the Proposed Transaction to any Competitor.

findings.title: Non-solicitation of employees
findings.why: This restricts AtliQ's ability to hire talent and is a long duration (24 months).
findings.comparison: Standard NDA practice is often mutual; this appears one-sided against the Recipient.
findings.quote: The Recipient shall not, during the term of this Agreement and for a period of twenty-four (24) months after its termination, directly or indirectly solicit, hire or engage any employee or consultant of the Company.

findings.title: Unilateral indemnity
findings.why: The indemnity is one-sided; AtliQ provides it, but the client does not.
findings.quote: The Recipient shall indemnify the Company for all losses, costs and expenses (including legal fees) arising from any breach of this Agreement by the Recipient or its Representatives.

findings.title: Injunctive relief without proof of damage
findings.why: Allows the client to seek court orders against AtliQ without proving actual harm.
findings.comparison: Common in NDAs, but broad as it lacks a requirement for proving irreparable harm.
findings.quote: the Company shall be entitled to injunctive relief and specific performance, without proof of actual damage, in addition to any other remedy.

findings.title: CloudSpan Technologies: Acting as implementation, reseller or referral partner for any competing cloud data-warehouse, lakehouse or analytics platform
findings.why: The exclusivity agreement with CloudSpan Technologies restricts acting as a partner for competing analytics platforms in India, which may conflict with the proposed data analytics services.
findings.comparison: Do not partner with another cloud data-warehouse or lakehouse vendor in India or the GCC while the CloudSpan agreement runs.
findings.quote: during the Term Partner and its Affiliates shall not act as an implementation, reseller or referral partner for any Competing Platform in India or the GCC.
findings.exception: Clause 7.3: does not restrict services outside India and the GCC, or to a customer that independently selected a platform, provided AtliQ holds no partner appointment with, and receives no fee from, that platform's provider.

findings.title: Asymmetric assignment rights
findings.why: Limits AtliQ's flexibility while granting the client broad assignment rights.
findings.quote: The Recipient may not assign this Agreement. The Company may assign it to any Affiliate.
